card.name: Letter after citation year
card.fires_on: A single letter such as a, b or d attached right after a four-digit year in a scientific citation. It marks which of several same-author, same-year papers is cited.

modes.label: Year suffix letter
modes.description: A letter directly after the year in an in-text or reference-list citation.

card.plain: It fires on the small a or b tacked onto a citation year to tell apart papers by the same author in the same year.
